label: Loft
tooltip: Body through sections of the scan along an axis.
help: Choose the axis: X, Y, Z, a fitted axis or a plane (sections perpendicular to its normal). Start and end are taken from the scan and can be dragged at the arrows. Every section must give one closed contour; with Only selected triangles, only part of the scan is sectioned. More sections follow strongly changing cross-sections more closely. With Start up to and End up to, the walls continue straight up to a plane.
emptyRange: The end must lie beyond the start.
